output.title: Night Shift
output.logline: A night nurse finds a chart for an empty room with her own name on it, and the porter who knows why will not say.
output.hookPromise: who wrote her name, and what happened in Room 9

characters.name: Mara
characters.role: she, 30s, a night-shift nurse who never misses a detail
characters.want: to know who wrote her name on the chart
characters.fear: that she is losing time she cannot remember
characters.secret: she worked a double shift last month and remembers none of it

characters.name: Dev
characters.role: he, 40s, the night porter who knows the old wing
characters.want: to keep Mara away from Room 9
characters.fear: that she will find out what happened last month
characters.secret: he has been writing the charts to warn her

output.arc: Mara finds her name on a chart for an empty room. Each night the room shows her more of a shift she cannot remember. Dev has been warning her the only way he can. The finale reveals the chart is dated tomorrow and the room is calling for her.

episodes.title: Room 9
episodes.hook: A chart slides off the trolley: tonight's admission is Mara herself.
beats: Mara finds a chart for Room 9 with her own name, admitted tonight.
She asks Dev who admitted her.
Dev goes still: Room 9 has been empty for years.
Down the dark corridor, the call light of Room 9 blinks on.

cliffhanger.moment: the call light of Room 9 blinks on in the dark
cliffhanger.line: Then who just pressed the call button?
cliffhanger.question: who is in the empty room?

episodes.title: Warm sheets
episodes.hook: The call light buzzes again; Mara is already walking toward it.
beats: Mara walks to Room 9 while Dev calls after her.
The room is empty, but the sheets are warm.
Her own name tag lies on the pillow.
The last chart entry is written in her handwriting.

cliffhanger.moment: she turns the chart toward us: the last entry is in her handwriting
cliffhanger.question: did she write it, and when?

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.hook: Mara holds up the chart: "Explain this, Dev."
beats: Dev admits he has been writing the charts to warn her.
Last month she worked a double shift she cannot remember.
The newest chart is dated tomorrow.
The ward phone rings: Room 9 is asking for her.

cliffhanger.moment: the ward phone rings; Dev listens, then holds it out to her
cliffhanger.question: who is waiting in Room 9 tomorrow?

output.reason: Two characters with opposite wants in one ward; every episode ends on a new piece of physical evidence (the call light, her handwriting, the phone), each re-hooked in the next cold open.
